t2i_prompt: Isometric technical line drawing of <CONTENT>, black ink on a pure white background, uniform hairline strokes with slightly heavier outer contours, no shading, no hatching, no fill, no colour and no text. Three-quarter isometric view from above, the object centred with a clean white margin. Precise mechanical detail: clamps, bolts, hinges, cable glands, flexible ribbed conduit, small tubing routed neatly between devices. Industrial equipment catalogue illustration, crisp closed contours suitable for converting into a single-colour mask.
signature_idea: A monitoring skid drawn as one quiet ink isometric where every sensor sits on a tubing route back to the main pipe.
strengths: clean single-weight line art converts cleanly to a token-coloured mask
credible pharma water instrumentation detail (sensors, sample valves, HMI)
isometric angle matches the rest of the drawing set
weaknesses: tri-clamp sanitary fittings read as stainless, not polypropylene
dense upper-right cabinet cluster can turn to noise at small sizes
cable tray is visually heavy for what it says
brand_fit_why: Precise, calm, single-colour line art paints well in navy or steel-blue, though fittings suggest stainless rather than PP.
